Please see to it personally.|[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Dagon Niriz]] and [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn]]|<ref name="CommandDecision">{{JournalCite|11|Command Decision}}</ref>}}
The '''TIE/sr starfighter''', or '''TIE scout''', was a limited production [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] used by the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] as a scout and light reconnaissance vessel. It was one of the many TIE variants in service during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Characteristics==
[[File:TIEscouthyperspace-TCGDL.jpg|thumb|left|200px|A TIE scout traveling through hyperspace]]
At 24 meters long, the TIE/sr was one of the largest TIE variants, and it was distinctive in appearance, with a tall, elongated main fuselage behind the cockpit, flanked by large, bent-wing solar panels. Although slow and not very maneuverable by starfighter standards, neither heavily armored nor heavily armed, it boasted an impressive suite of [[com-scan]] equipment, and its enlarged hull could accommodate a crew of up to three, sometimes including a second [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]].

The most notable feature of the TIE scout was that it carried the most capable [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]] of any TIE variant. In contrast to the [[TIE/rc starfighter]] and [[TIE/rc vanguard|TIE Vanguard]] fighters, which were capable of only sublight reconnaissance ahead of their [[Carrier/Legends|carrier]], the TIE scout could undertake extended [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]] missions without being at the mercy of a capital ship, like most other TIE models.

It was also capable of making a [[Sensor/Legends|sensor]] [[Sensor ping|ping]] that could reveal unseen enemies.

The TIE scout proved to be too expensive for mass production.

===Civilian model===
Unlike most other TIE designs, the TIE scout also had a civilian variant. The [[Lone Scout-A]], designed as an exploration vessel and armed with a single chin-mounted cannon. This variant could carry three passengers and supplies for up to a year, and boasted a cargo capacity comparing favorably with many [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighters]]: up to 60 cubic meters by volume, or 150 metric tons by weight. Since the Lone Scout-A had shields, the design was still used by the Imperial Navy, as the TIE scout was in need of supplementary designs.

==History==
[[File:CCG_Limited_Premier.jpg|thumb|right|A [[TIE series/Legends|TIE]] scout.]]
Several TIE scouts were carried aboard [[Mitth'raw'nuruodo/Legends|Thrawn's]] [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], ''[[Admonitor]]'', when he was posted to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]]. They may have been design ancestors of the similarly-sized TIE-variant scout ships later used by the pilots of [[Syndic Mitth'raw'nuruodo's Household Phalanx]] based at the [[Hand of Thrawn]].

During the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]], TIE scouts were mostly used in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] as a scout fighter to scan locations for reconnaissance, and to detect minefields or potential ambushes in advance to the arrival of other forces. The high cost of the vessel prevented the Empire from using it more extensively, which kept the available units consigned to the most needed areas.<ref name="EAWGG" />
